svg.title: Marauder Console
svg.desc: The React UI, in a browser tab or the Tauri desktop window, talks only to the local Python bridge. The bridge is the single owner of the USB serial port: it writes each command to the ESP32 and streams the board's output back over a WebSocket while recording the session to disk. The Claude assistant runs inside the bridge, reads saved sessions and captures, and can only propose commands for you to run; it never reaches the board, and it is the only call that leaves your computer. run a command: React UI → bridge.py → ESP32 Marauder. live output: ESP32 Marauder → bridge.py → React UI, Saved data. ask the assistant: React UI → bridge.py → Assistant → Saved data, Claude API.

g.text: sole owner of the serial port
